column1: # MTA bus service per hexagon (weekday schedule)
#   - MTA bus GTFS: MTA Bus Company: https://rrgtfsfeeds.s3.amazonaws.com/gtfs_busco.zip
#   bus_stops: bus stops inside the hexagon with service on the sample weekday
#   bus_routes: distinct bus routes stopping in the hexagon
#   sbs_routes: Select Bus Service routes stopping in the hexagon
#   bus_stop_events_weekday: bus stops made in the hexagon on the weekday (a trip stopping at 3 stops here counts 3)
#   bus_trips_weekday: distinct bus trips stopping in the hexagon at least once on the weekday
#   bus_trips_peak_per_hour: distinct bus trips per hour stopping in the hexagon
#   express_trips_peak_per_hour: express bus trips per hour stopping in the hexagon
column2: 7-10 am (a sign of long commutes to Manhattan)

column1: #   bus_trips_per_km2: bus_trips_weekday per km² of hexagon land

#   Both directions count; a route running every 10 minutes each way gives ~12 trips per hour.

column2: so a busy route along a hexagon edge may be split between neighbours.
